2608.16390.title: Counting Documents Is Not Counting Text: Unit Bias in Web-PDF Corpus Statistics
2608.16390.paper_summary: PDF corpora advertise their size in tokens but compute every rate they publish (coverage, OCR routing, re-fetch recovery, language mix) per document, and none decomposes its token total. The two units diverge sharply. On CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED (7.9M web PDFs, 32.6B tokens), 3.02% of text-bearing documents hold half the tokens (Gini 0.807); documents over 50 pages are 5.00% of the corpus but 53.53% of its text. The PDFs produced by a TeX{} toolchain are 1.66% of documents and 4.05% of the text. The clearest casualty is Common Crawl's truncation cap: it affected 23.06% of documents and 63.08% of the text. Reconstructing the truncated files and extracting both versions, two widely used libraries recover 11.4% and 1.4% of that text; between 72% and 97% of affected documents yield nothing; roughly 55--62% of the corpus's text is lost. Under the 5 MiB cap adopted in March 2025, 30.19% of tokens would still be truncated, and recovery on those documents rises only from 3.3% to 13.2%. We recommend that corpus statistics be reported in both units: documents and tokens.
2608.16390.paper_summary_zh: PDF 語料庫以標記數量宣傳其規模，但計算他們發布的每個比率（覆蓋率、OCR 路由、重新獲取恢復、語言混合）時，都是按文件計算，且沒有一個將其標記總數分解。這兩個單位的差異非常明顯。在 CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED（7.9M 網頁 PDF，32.6B 標記）中，3.02% 的文本承載文件擁有一半的標記（基尼係數 0.807）；超過 50 頁的文件占語料庫的 5.00%，但占其文本的 53.53%。由 TeX{} 工具鏈生成的 PDF 佔文件的 1.66% 和文本的 4.05%。最明顯的受害者是 Common Crawl 的截斷上限：它影響了 23.06% 的文件和 63.08% 的文本。重建截斷文件並提取兩個版本的兩個廣泛使用的庫恢復了 11.4% 和 1.4% 的文本；受影響的文件中有 72% 到 97% 沒有任何產出；大約 55--62% 的語料庫文本丟失。在 2025 年 3 月採用的 5 MiB 上限下，30.19% 的標記仍將被截斷，對這些文件的恢復率僅從 3.3% 上升到 13.2%。我們建議語料庫統計應以兩個單位報告：文件和標記。
2608.16390.author: Luca Foppiano et.al.
